# #8921: admitted brace-elision pairs that are EFFECTIVE AT MORE THAN ONE
# declaring schema site.
#
# `compactNormalizeInScope(containerKeyword, head)` takes NO PARENT CONTEXT. It
# is keyed on a (container keyword, head) string pair, so an admission applies
# at EVERY site where a container of that keyword declares that head -- not at
# the site it was adjudicated on. Every row below was adjudicated by measuring
# one fixture at one site and is live at the number of sites in column 2.
#
# FORMAT: <container> <head>\t<declaring site count>
#
# WHAT "DECLARING SITE" MEANS, because #8921 reports a different headline and
# the difference is the whole point:
#
#   A pair is EFFECTIVE at a site when a container of that keyword declares
#   that head there. Where the container exists but does NOT declare the head,
#   the admission has no effect -- the predicate is never consulted for a pair
#   that cannot form.
#
# #8921's headline of 223 is not reproducible: its probe was a throwaway file,
# run and removed. Measured here at 575 admitted pairs (it had 547):
#
#     declaring sites > 1                                 163   <- this file
#     container keyword occurs > 1, head may not declare  327
#
# 223 falls between the two, so it used a third variant. What DOES reproduce
# exactly is #8921's per-pair table -- all ten of its named rows match this
# instrument to the count (bfd minimum-interval 8, multiplier 8,
# forwarding-class loss-priority 7, loss-priority code-points 7, route
# next-hop 6, match destination-address 5, match source-address 5, then log 5,
# interface cost 4, hello-interval 4). The argument in that issue rests on the
# per-row data, which holds; only the aggregate is unreproducible.
#
# `groups` is EXCLUDED. It mirrors the entire schema, so counting it makes
# every pair multi-site by construction (measured: 575 of 575) and the
# distinction this file exists to draw disappears.
#
# THIS FILE IS A RATCHET, NOT AN ALLOWLIST. A row here is not adjudicated at
# its extra sites -- it is RECORDED as being live at them, which is the debt
# #8921 says is currently unpaid. Adding a row means a new admission is
# effective somewhere nobody measured it; removing one means an admission
# narrowed. Both directions must move deliberately.
#
